title: mkdshare.DEV
description: Publish and share access-controlled Markdown documents from any MCP-enabled AI tool.
summary: Publish and share access-controlled Markdown documents from any MCP-enabled AI tool.
offersHint: Publish and share access-controlled Markdown documents from any MCP-enabled AI tool. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mkdshare.dev/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from your mkdshare.DEV account (sign in at mkdshare.dev → API & MCP)

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer token from your mkdshare.DEV account (sign in at mkdshare.dev → API & MCP)

toolsPreview.name: list_documents
toolsPreview.description: List all mkdshare.DEV documents owned by or shared with the authenticated user.

toolsPreview.name: get_document
toolsPreview.description: Read the full markdown content of a document by its slug.

toolsPreview.name: create_document
toolsPreview.description: Create a new mkdshare.DEV document. If visibility is omitted the document is owner-only (login_required, restricted to your email).

toolsPreview.name: update_document
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing document you own. Omit any field to keep its current value.

toolsPreview.name: list_annotations
toolsPreview.description: List all annotations (comments) on a document.

toolsPreview.name: create_annotation
toolsPreview.description: Add an annotation (comment) to a document. Pass quoted_text with the exact passage you want to annotate — the server will locate it automatically. Omit quoted_text to attach to the whole document. You can also provide start_offset + end_offset explicitly if needed.

toolsPreview.name: archive_document
toolsPreview.description: Archive a document. For documents you own, archives it for everyone. For shared documents, archives it only for you.

toolsPreview.name: search_documents
toolsPreview.description: Search mkdshare.DEV documents by title and content. Returns documents owned by or shared with the authenticated user that match the query.

toolsPreview.name: upload_image
toolsPreview.description: Upload an image (png, jpeg, gif, webp; max 1MB) for embedding in documents. Returns a URL and a ready-to-paste markdown snippet. Images are served at an unguessable URL — anyone with the exact link can view.

toolsPreview.name: request_device_auth
toolsPreview.description: Start a headless Google sign-in. Call this FIRST if you don't have an API token yet. Returns a user_code and verification_url for the user to visit, plus a device_code to use with poll_device_auth. No Bearer token required.

toolsPreview.name: poll_device_auth
toolsPreview.description: Check whether the user has approved the device authorization. Call every 5 seconds (or the interval returned by a slow_down response) until status is 'complete'. Save the returned api_token to your MCP server config.
